answer: Shards are assigned from the forge graph, and therefore cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The trellis assignment is published and mirror records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4738 identities would post 4666 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
